concept.title: Lunch clubs and food clubs
concept.shortdesc: Attending a regular lunch, dinner or food club where people share a meal or collect low-cost food.

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.

ul.li: eating a meal with others socially: belongs in a neighbouring group that is not yet a category (general shared meals)
getting lunch on site: see (single meal, no club)

section.title: Evidence and status

strow.stentry: Draft, not reviewed. The group re-formed in most resamplings of the data (stability 0.81).
Bristol (10), Dorset (7), North Lincolnshire (4), Open Sessions (1)
Mixed: the group holds more than one kind of service. Split into social lunch and dinner clubs and food clubs where members pick up a share of low-cost food.

section.p: Identifier in this run: svc-076. Identifiers are cluster numbers of one run and change whenever the clustering is re-run; they are not stable ids.
